fields.name: temperature_2m
fields.description: Ambient dry bulb temperature 2 meters above ground

intendedUse: Providing meteorological exogenous features for traffic congestion forecasting and building HVAC energy demand predictions.
prohibitedClaims: Reanalysis and numerical weather prediction outputs must not be represented as calibrated hyper-local automated weather station (AWS) observations directly installed on the corridor.
knownLimitations: Grid cell resolution of numerical reanalysis models (~11 km) smooths out hyper-local urban heat island effects and pavement microclimates.
privacySensitivityAssessment: Public atmospheric observations. Zero privacy or security constraints.
